title: connection_whitelisted let _ suppressor has no comment explaining purpose
description: session.rs line 198: 'let _ = connection_whitelisted;' suppresses the unused-variable lint, but a reader unfamiliar with this Rust idiom may not know that. The existing comment explains when to remove the line ('remove when greylisting (stoa-ef702cf6) consumes this') but not why it exists now. Fix: add a brief inline note, e.g.: 'let _ = connection_whitelisted; // suppress unused-variable lint until greylisting (stoa-ef702cf6) consumes this'
